items.name: Cozy Cubing Poway 2023
items.information: Competitors at this competition are encouraged to wear pajamas! If you come dressed in pajamas you will be given one raffle ticket and entered into a raffle for a prize! The raffle will be held during lunch. This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/CozyCubingPoway2023#23980-competitor-responsibilities) tab. ![This competition is in partnership with West Coast Cubing, LLC](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBc29SIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e561d0a9c0d6249576e169bfde3e7dbcbf20fe23/wcc-banner.png)

items.name: Montevideo al Cubo 2023

venue.name: [Grupo Altavista Lab & Trend](https://www.grupoaltavista.com.uy/)
venue.address: Av. Uruguay 1529, 11200 Montevideo, Departamento de Montevideo.
venue.details: La competencia está en la entrada / You will see the competition at the entrance

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcElrIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--4be3c11536038145829dbcba17ca15bdea04981e/imagen.png) # 🇺🇾 Hay un límite de 35 competidores para el registro. * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors). * Se debe tener en cuenta que los competidores pueden ser descalificados en los casos que prevé el Reglamento de la WCA. No se realizan reembolsos de ningún tipo por descalificación, según el artículo [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores tienen que estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama, de no ser así, se penalizará al competidor con la descalificación del evento (de la ronda, no de toda la competencia), de acuerdo con el artículo [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) del reglamento. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda consultar a los organizadores o a los delegados de la WCA. # 🇬🇧 Competitor limit: 35. * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24769-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoalCubo2023#24770-competidores-nuevos-new-competitors). * Note that competitors may be disqualified under the circumstances described in the WCA Regulations. A disqualified competitor is not eligible for the refund of any expenses due to participating in the competition, as per regulation [2l1](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2l1). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called, otherwise the competitor will be penalized with the disqualification of the event, in accordance with regulation [2u](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#2u) of the WCA Regulations. * It is important to read all the information available in the competition website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.

items.name: U24 Tetiana Day 2023
items.information: ### Змагання на підтримку України 🇺🇦. ##### 50% внесків будуть передані фандрейзинговій платформі [United24](https://u24.gov.ua/). ##### Всі відвідувачі змагань мають обов’язково ознайомитись з розділом ["Запобіжні заходи"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/U24TetianaDay2023#24524-safety-measures). Обговорення змагань буде відбуватись в [Телеграмі](https://t.me/kubikinua). ### Competition in support of Ukraine 🇺🇦. ##### 50% fees will be donated to the fundraising platform [United24](https://u24.gov.ua/). ##### All visitors MUST read the section ["Safety measures"](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/U24TetianaDay2023#24524-safety-measures) carefully. Discussion of the competition will be held in [Telegram](https://t.me/kubikinua).
